It was very pleasing to see Dick Tobin again, back from Ireland. Also Corporal Dumbrill, who was in the R.E.'s team from Hampshire. Also Frank Jeffries, who was with the R.A.M.C. team, from Hampshire.
Our Canadian friend Page scored a double by winning the 100 and 220 yds. In the former he was chased home by the Fire Services champion Rowe and in the 220 our own Dumbrill was 2nd and Rowe 3rd.
Individual winners, together with the placings of our Club representatives, are given hereunder:— 100 Yards—1 Liffen (MP); 2 Clay (B); 3 Dumbrill (B).

There were two heats in the 100 yards sprint, and we were especially pleased to see Dumbrill and Nankeville competing. With the first three in each heat qualifying for the final, it was a closely contested race, and M.
Our lads had turned up in good strength, and with Read and Dumbrill, we had first two home in both sprint races. Len Marchant ran a grand race to beat the Police champion, D.
The 100 Yards Club Championship was won by Ted Read, who beat Dicky Dumbrill with Jack Frost third, and the holder, Stan Botwright, beaten into fourth place.
Wickerson, running for Cambridge H., won the 100 Yards with George Pallett beating Dicky Dumbrill for second place.
